name: io.github.chrischall/workvivo-mcp
description: Read-only Workvivo for Claude — feed, news, events, people and search via your signed-in session

environmentVariables.name: WORKVIVO_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Your organization's Workvivo host, e.g. acme.workvivo.us.

environmentVariables.name: WORKVIVO_DEBUG
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to log verbose request detail to stderr.

environmentVariables.name: WORKVIVO_MAX_DOWNLOAD_MB
environmentVariables.description: Documents larger than this are skipped, not downloaded (default 50).

environmentVariables.name: WORKVIVO_SKIP_FILE_TYPES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated extensions or MIME types never downloaded, e.g. mp4,.mov,video/* (default video/*,audio/*; none = skip nothing).
